reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives EPA and WPA are constructed as differences in expected points and win probabilities across sequential game states. They are validated through Pearson correlations with referee data, ensuring fidelity to observed outcomes. The player-grain transition kernel enables fine-resolution modeling of how individual actions propagate through the game state space. These operators are not projections but descriptive measures of historical play impact. Their failure modes include data misalignment, insufficient granularity, or absence of referee validation. The dual nature of these metrics—both descriptive and predictive—requires careful handling of causality and temporal consistency.
